title: Allergy Action Plan Medical Authorization Form
subtitle: An original operational medical authorization for allergy action plan that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Allergy Action Plan Medical Authorization Form supports the complete allergy action plan workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Allergy Action Plan Medical Authorization Form when the assigned allergy-plan coordinator needs one fillable record for approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Allergy action plan medical authorization identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this medical authorization to one approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

fields.label: School, program, meal, or activity site

blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

sections.title: Allergy action plan authorized health source and operating scope
sections.guidance: Transcribe supplied directions exactly and keep diagnosis or clinical interpretation out of this record.

blocks.label: Authorization and qualified source
Allergy action plan supplied health and response information
items: Guardian authorization and allergy-plan effective period
Qualified health-plan source and reviewer
Allergens and exposure routes exactly as supplied
Symptoms, action sequence, and stop conditions exactly as supplied
Emergency medication and administration direction reference
Authorized staff, backup response, and activity setting
Emergency services and guardian contact route
Private plan storage, staff access, update, and handoff requirements

blocks.label: Authorized item, exact supplied direction, applicability, source, and review
Medical and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records an allergy action-plan workflow; it does not diagnose an allergy, interpret symptoms, invent exposure limits, or replace qualified directions or emergency services. Use only the current approved plan and authorization. Stop routine activity for any mismatch, suspected exposure, symptom, or unavailable control, protect privacy, and route response decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan custody, staff readiness, and read-back
sections.guidance: Confirm the approved source, staff authority, setting, storage, and handoff before use.

blocks.label: Custody and authorized operating route
Allergy action plan authorization readiness
items: Allergy plan is tied to the correct student identity
Guardian and qualified plan sources are current
Allergens and exposure routes are copied from the approved plan
Meal, snack, classroom, transport, and activity controls are routed
Emergency medication and supply custody is confirmed
Symptoms, action sequence, and stop conditions come from the current plan
Authorized staff and backup response coverage are known
Emergency services and guardian contact routes are available
Privacy and minimum-necessary staff access are defined
Any mismatch, exposure, symptom, or missing control stops routine activity

blocks.label: Item or record custody, condition, count, owner, and evidence
Exact read-back, unresolved mismatch, staff limitation, and qualified-review question

fields.label: Read-back, mismatch, staff limitation, and review question

sections.title: Allergy action plan response conditions, stop controls, and decision
sections.guidance: Do not guess or improvise; stop and use the documented escalation route on any mismatch.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring hold, stop, or escalation
items: Student identity, allergen, plan, or emergency supply does not match
Plan is missing, illegible, expired, changed, or unavailable
Food label, ingredient, meal, snack, or cross-contact control is unclear
Emergency medication, trained staff, or required setting is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or administration event occurred
Classroom, transport, field trip, or activity environment changed
Immediate breathing, circulation, consciousness, or other emergency concern is active
Response, supply count, notification, or follow-up does not reconcile

blocks.label: Condition, observed fact, immediate action, contact, and outcome
Allergy action plan operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized allergy-response staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan exceptions, notification, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve unknowns, assign correction, and record the accountable recipient.

blocks.label: Authorization and response exceptions
items: Routine activity cannot proceed under the current allergy plan
Guardian authorization or qualified plan direction is incomplete
Student, allergen, plan, medication, or supply does not reconcile
Meal, activity, cross-contact, staffing, or setting control is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or emergency response is active
Response, supply custody, notification, or follow-up remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, evidence or action needed, owner, due point, and disposition

sections.title: Allergy action plan outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan closeout controls
items: Allergy-plan readiness and response status accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved exposure, control, or supply action has an owner
Emergency medication and equipment returned to approved custody
Meal, facility, health, or program follow-up linked
Allergy record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome and next action
Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Medical Authorization closeout acknowledgment
